reason: A DSH web plugin for selecting local Wallpaper Engine images, videos, and compatible scene textures as the workspace background, with adjustable surface transparency and local configuration persistence.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中浏览本地 Wallpaper Engine 媒体，并将图片、视频或兼容场景纹理设置为背景及调整界面透明度。
summaries.en: Browse local Wallpaper Engine media in the DeepSeek Harness web interface and use images, videos, or compatible scene textures as the background with adjustable surface transparency.

capabilities: Discovers Steam library and Wallpaper Engine project files on the local Windows machine
Reads supported local image, video, and scene texture media
Serves selected local media through plugin HTTP routes to the connected DSH web client
Persists wallpaper selection and transparency settings locally
Changes the DSH background and surface transparency
Opens a user-initiated link to the Wallpaper Engine Workshop
